full_track.tags: K-Pop ballad featuring a baritone male vocal. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing arpeggiated chords and a legato string section providing harmonic swells. A clean electric guitar performs subtle melodic fills with light chorus and delay. The percussion is minimal, consisting of a soft kick drum and a rimshot on the backbeat. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal performance uses a mix of chest voice and breathy delivery, with occasional vibrato on sustained notes. The production features high-fidelity clarity with a hall reverb on the vocals and strings.
